findings.action: Evaluate adopted exemptions before the no-bundles shortcut. Schema 5 accepts review_bundles=false, and adopting this capability does not enable bundles. For an aggregate with no own review, computeReviewVerification follows its legacy-attempt path: ReviewCheck returns Required=false and Fresh=true for the exemption but Approved=false. This early return prevents the adopted exemption projection from running, so VerifyReviewBundle remains needs-review even after a valid explicit closeout receipt exists, whereas closeout-check can report terminal. Preserve exemption and receipt semantics for supported legacy-attempt instances, or explicitly enforce and document the prerequisite before adoption. Cover milestone and roadmap verification before and after close with bundles disabled.
Make predecessor warnings consult the adopted aggregate terminal projection, preserving legacy behavior, and add coverage for approved and exempt predecessors without receipts.
findings.rationale: Use adopted terminal standing for predecessor start warnings. startWarnings still calls scopeApproved, which treats a never exemption or an aggregate's own approval as satisfied without its closeout receipt. A dependent member's start plan therefore omits the existing not-closed warning while its predecessor remains open. Authoritative closeout acceptance still blocks the dependency, limiting this to an advisory inconsistency.

findings.action: Do not let failed inherited exemptions disappear from a roadmap's child verification. The exemption result sets inherited=true, and the child-failure branch at line 3556 clears Approved without clearing that marker. reviewBundleChildren at line 1820 accepts any error-free inherited result and continues without propagating its blockers; an exempt milestone has no Bundle to retain. With milestone=never and a roadmap holding its own approved review, rejecting a member makes the milestone fail but leaves it omitted from the roadmap's sealed and current child collections. The roadmap's own review verification can remain approved and, with its receipt, closed, although GetCloseoutState rejects the descendant. Require standing before skipping an inherited child and preserve a live verification obligation for exempt milestones without bundles. Cover an independently reviewed roadmap over an exempt milestone before and after member rejection.
